running containers, writing your own images and keeping them secure

files and data on the command line, batch processing and building small tools

irene.relation: ALX ProDev Backend and Frontend, Project Nexus
irene.name: Irene Aragona
irene.quote: It wasn’t easy, but you nailed it — delivering outstanding work and earning one of the highest scores in your Cohort.
irene.full: “It’s been a while since you completed your program — and I’m sure Project Nexus still stands out as one of the biggest challenges of your journey! After four months of learning, you wrapped things up with an ambitious, fully fledged project. It wasn’t easy, but you nailed it — delivering outstanding work and earning one of the highest scores in your Cohort.” Project Nexus was the capstone for both ProDev Backend and ProDev Frontend, which I took at the same time.
